final: WITH ch AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS b, AVG(f.feerate) AS a FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE o.orderbase IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.orderbase HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL), bm AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM ch) SELECT AVG(ch.a) AS mean_avg_feerate_above_benchmark, AVG(ch.a - bm.m) AS mean_excess_over_benchmark FROM ch, bm WHERE ch.a > bm.m
